name: rooms
summary: The game's closed rooms measured cell by cell: volume, pressure, temperature, gases, heat, bounds. Every room, or the room one thing is in. Lists 10. Read only.

help.text: A room is a closed flood fill of 2 m cells (at most 1200; a bigger or open space is outside). The air is summed fresh from each cell, as the game pools a room. Largest room first, with count and local_player_room_id. Devices come with include_devices, cell centres with include_cells.
help.keys: rooms [{room_id, room_type, cell_count, volume_l, pressure_kpa, temperature_k, total_mol, heat_capacity_j_per_k, ...}], count, local_player_room_id.

reply.text: room_id, room_type, cell_count, volume_l, pressure_kpa, temperature_k, total_mol, heat_capacity_j_per_k, thermal_energy_j, gases [{gas, amount_mol, ratio}] largest first (traces under 1e-9 mol left out), bounds {min, max} (the box of the cell centres), contains_local_player, devices and cells. Sample thermal_energy_j twice: its change over the seconds between is the room's net heat flow in watts, gas moved in or out included.

refusals.text: With reference_id: thing_not_found when nothing has it; not_in_room when its cell is outside (an item in a slot counts where its outermost holder is). room_not_found elsewhere means the room id names no room.

reference_id.description: Any thing: only the room its cell is in.

include_cells.description: List every cell centre of each room. Default false.

include_devices.description: List the devices in each room. Default false.
